reviews.t: described as leather but you had to search the fine print to find that it is "pu
reviews.x: If it's not leather, don't use the word. I felt this description was deceptive, described as leather but you had to search the fine print to find that it is "pu," which stands for polyurethane. Can't believe the other reviews raved about this cheap plastic bag. The box was far better than the contents. Mine was immediately sent packin' back to Nevada

Disappointing. Like some other reviewers have noted, this product has such an awful odor that I'm going to probably wind up returning it. It took me a minute to figure out what it smells like, and I finally nailed it. No exaggeration, it smells like chicken or pork that has begun to go bad. I have tried various methods to deodorize it, but after about two and a half weeks I'm not sure anything is going to work.  Update July 8th 2018. I didn't wind up returning it because it got to be past Amazon

reviews.t: ... bought this travel bag for myself and it is perfect for what I needed it for
reviews.x: I bought this travel bag for myself and it is perfect for what I needed it for. I go out of town every weekend and this bag is the perfect size for my makeup and toiletries. It is not real leather but it still has a very classy look to it. All the zippers work great, I am satisfied with my purchase.

reviews.t: surprisingly received by its packaging — looks like a nice gift
reviews.x: Randomly chosed this product by reviewing some similar products, surprisingly received by its packaging — looks like a nice gift. It has some leather smell but not a big deal for me. Waterproof material inside. Price worthy.

I absolutely love the product, and would give it a higher score except for one thing - the smell. It took us all day to figure out where the smell was coming from. We thought something had gotten inside and died somewhere in the house (we live in the country). Imagine our disgust & surprise to realize it was this object. I am trying to get rid of the smell by cleaning it multiple times. If I find something that works, I will share it with the rest of you.

reviews.t: I agrees about the foul smell of this bag as another review mentioned
reviews.x: I agrees about the foul smell of this bag as another review mentioned. Odor is most noticeable when opened up Overall, the bag is nice. In time, I hope the odor is gone. I agree with other comments about the room inside. The hook it has is a nice idea. This bag is a bit softer then the one I had before which was a rectangle shape zip around type and had a little more stiffness to it.

Nice looking but smells like it had a dead fish in it!! Should have returned asap but thought by airing it out, spraying with cologne, and washing it through the washing machine would get the smell out, but it didn't.  Still smells just as bad as it did when received it.  It is now going in the trash!

First of all, I love the packaging! I bought it as a gift for my husband and now all I'll have to do is wrap it. I did take it out and peek. The material is nice, there are many compartments and the zipper looks durable.

Gifted this to my husband who travels a lot for work and he loves it. The material is sturdy and holds its shape, and wipes clean easily. My husband has been using it for about 8 months now and it’s held up wonderfully 😁
I bought this as a present for my father. He liked the look of it and planned to use it, but upon opening the packaging it has a foul smell that will not go away. For that reason he doesn't use it.

reviews.t: I like it and it will do the job for me
reviews.x: I like it and it will do the job for me. It does have a odor to it but I put a bar of unwrapped Spring soap in it for about week and now it smells great.
I left this thing open, outside for 2 days thinking it might take car of the smell, no luck. I've used it for a week now and still stinks.
Bought this for my husband because he didn’t have a toiletry bag and he really likes it. I think it perfect for travel!

reviews.t: ... your luggage and stain the bag ，this bag very easy to clean
reviews.x: this design not spillage in your luggage and stain the bag ，this bag very easy to clean.  .

It was exactly how it was described by the seller and in the reviews, and it was a nice size and looked well made. I can't wait to give this as a gift to my best friend, he needed exactly this!  Edit: I ordered this again (I ordered it in 2016). And a few things have changed: 1.)  it comes in a little drawstring bag now instead of a box, which for my purposes was better, but the box was nicer 2.) they included a lavender saschet to help from the smell, I never minded the smell, it went away quic

reviews.t: Try for yourself before buying as a gift
reviews.x: The durability and sturdiness of the bag I cannot testify to because I am giving it as a gift. This is my first time ordering these bags on line. I have 3 grandsons and a son-inlaw. I ordered each one a bag from a different seller. This bag arrived promptly as described. I was surprised at how small the bag was but other than that my experience was good. The bag was folded up inside a plastic bag when I opened it. I was not impressed with the bag of the presentation when I first opened the packa

I’m a little surprised, because the bag really doesn’t look like the original pictures😬 While it seems functional, it doesn’t seem very fashionable as I had imagined when I purchased this! In person the bag appears to be very orange rather than a weathered leather type of look. In person it appears to look more “cheapish” than the original picture appears! It does not seem like a bad bad, just very very different from what I expected when I ordered this!

I bought this for my husband for Father's Day and did not get to use it until July 4th to travel to Costa Rica and by the time we got down there and unpacked it smelled like rotten fish (like fish sauce) and we just can't stand it! Everything else about the bag is awesome, spacious, and feels and looks nice but we can't use it smelling like that!  So bummed!

I should’ve read the reviews for this before I bought it. It’s pretty good quality but smells like “trout bait” according to my brother. To me it smelled very fishy! I bought this for my husband to use for work since he works out there. No way he’d use it with that smell! I will be returning this. I bought this at a discounted rate for my honest review.

I bought this bag for my boyfriend and when I first got it, it didn't smell too bad but the smell never went away and it smells like FISH hardcore. I tried washing the bag and everything and it still stinks like fish. IT IS GROSS. We can't return it so we are throwing it away because it is making everything in the bag smell like fish. DO NOT BUY!!!

reviews.t: Excellent toiletry bag.Very useful and easy to carry
reviews.x: Nice Travel bag with lots of space. Waterproof lining, so anything that spills inside can easily be wiped up. A very good product as this price.Waterproof material, User friendly design and a excellent product to gift someone. It is heavy-duty two ways zipper; multi-compartment for well organized; extra cushion, protect your belongs from shocking.

This bag ended up being much better quality than I expected! I bought it for my boyfriend for an up coming trip. But oh my god the SMELL. It’s god awful. I’m embarrassed to even gift it to him... it’s been airing for several days now... they threw in a scent packet and it smells like a 100 year old woman. Made the entire bag wreak.

I bought this as a gift for my son and he absolutely loves it.  It's not too big and not too small.  It fits all of his toiletries nicely and doesn't take up too much space in his suitcase or duffle bag.  You certainly can't beat the price either.  I would definitely recommend.

I bought this for my brother as a Christmas present and I was absolutely impressed by the quality. The colour is also exactly as the picture which makes for a pretty awesome gift. I can't wait for my brother to tell me what he thinks.  PS: the box it came in is super cool too!

reviews.t: Good bag, once you de-stink it.
reviews.x: This bag holds a ton of stuff and the hanger is handy, but wow does it stink. It's faux leather and it smells like chemicals or burning plastic. We hung it up and sprayed it with Febreze and it still held some stank after three days. Seems ok now, a few weeks after purchase.

claims.text: Many reviewers report a strong, foul odor that lingers even after airing out or washing.
Reviewers frequently praise the bag's look, packaging, and suitability as a gift.
Some reviewers note the material is not real leather, with one calling the 'leather' description deceptive.
Reviewers describe the bag as sturdy, well-made, and easy to clean.
A few reviewers mention the odor can be remedied or is tolerable.
